[← Back to Demos Gallery](index.qmd)

The live application below is running completely client-side in your browser using serverless **Shinylive** (WebAssembly). It provides a streamlined **Systems Ethology platform (`sysetholApp()`)** with clean sidebar controls (`sysetholInput`), dynamic conditional panels (`Steps per click` log-scale geometric slider when `nsim = 1`, `Confidence Band` when `nsim > 1`), sidebar **Run Engine** & **Reset** buttons, and modular tabs (`sysetholOutput`: **Dist Plots** fine time-granularity step plots, **Substrate Plots**, **Envelope Plots**, and **Input Data** via `inputApp`).

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 880
#| components: [viewer]

webr::install("byandell/ewing")
library(ewing)

sysetholApp()
```

---

## Programmatic Application Usage

Launch the **Systems Ethology Platform** natively in R using exported package functions:

```r
library(ewing)

sysetholApp()
```
